It asks viewers to care for surroundings by feeding or watering local animals and planting trees. It then focuses on reducing single-use plastic, citing low recycling rates, landfill and water-body pollution, microplastics in water and bodies, and harm to wildlife. Finally, it urges reducing meat consumption, arguing that animal agriculture contributes heavily to greenhouse gases, land use, deforestation, antibiotic use, and environmental damage.
